take: Per the Flyers' announcement, Philadelphia recalled Cole Knuble, Alex Bump and Jacob Gaucher from Lehigh Valley (AHL) and placed Owen Tippett on injured reserve. Tippett had played 16:39 a night on the first line and second power-play unit. In the two games he has missed, Christian Dvorak has moved up to 19:42 a night alongside Zegras and Couturier, and Michael Bunting is up to 12:53. The Flyers hold 35% of the 5-on-5 chances by quality (expected goals), and Tippett's own share was 32%.
